title: Ignition Specifications — 3.7L Duratec
introduction:
The coil supplies voltage; the spark plug gives it a controlled gap across which to start combustion. I keep this Duratec specification beside the engine identity, because a familiar-looking plug is a poor substitute for the right reference.

The table pairs a Spark plug identifier with a gap range in inches and millimeters. Read both endpoints of the range—this is a window, not a single target hidden in the middle. The sheet does not establish a complete replacement ordering number or teach access, gap adjustment or tightening.

edits.text: Spark Plug Identification and Gap Range
edits.why: Select this reference for the stated Duratec engine. The Spark plug row provides its printed identifier; the Spark plug gap row provides the dimensional range. Keep the range endpoints and units together, and use the matching service procedure for any physical work.
